title: Building an LLM-Powered Text-Based AI RPG
author: fisj

comments.author: fisj
comments.body:
Note: I am not the author of this video, but saw it come up on my searches for LLM RPG implementations.

The video presents a small but nice implementation of an RPG style combat encounter. He does some pretty interesting things like add in a feasibility metric. Def worth a watch.
